description: Publish, unpublish (draft), archive or reprice many products at once. Prices: price.mode "percent" in basis points (-1000 = 10% off, 500 = 5% up), "amount" adds minor units (negative lowers), "set" sets the price. Price changes return a preview of old → new prices; only send confirm: true after the owner approves that preview. Money is an integer in minor units: $199.90 MXN is 19990.

mode.description: set: new price. percent: basis points up (+) or down (-), -1000 = 10% off. amount: minor units up or down.

title: Bulk product changes
